root_cause: The existing original admin System Map projected aggregate incident counts and provider release state, but not the already-written original ONE BRAIN observed-state entry for the V1 UX rollout; owner had no authenticated, proof-aware panel for open UX acceptance gaps.
fix: Use an original admin-only, tenant-gated server-side allowlisted Supabase observation read and compact projection on existing System Map. The client independently compares stored production SHA against current provider-published SHA, and distinguishes technical release proof from unverified WCAG, SUS, tenant testing and award evaluation.
prevention_rules: Every original UX release observation has an admin-only allowlisted projection; no new persistence and no raw incident evidence in the client.
Technical live requires current published Netlify SHA match, not stored status text.
Expired record, provider error or missing auth gives UNVERIFIED, never 0 or green.
Independent authenticated admin browser, two-tenant and WCAG tests remain separate acceptance gates.
owner: original Portal V2 admin observability and ONE BRAIN production-state owner
terminal_rule: Cannot call verified portal visibility until protected merge, exact Netlify deployment, authorized admin+tenant browser readback and no-leak tests pass.
